newsitem.title: TAIWAN: China Airlines starts Miami cargo service.
newsitem.headline: China Airlines starts Miami cargo service.

text.p: Taiwan carrier China Airlines said on Friday it has started a weekly cargo service to Miami, aiming to promote business links between Taiwan and Latin America.

"Miami is the main hub to central and South America in the United States," China Airlines said in a statement. "The new cargo service will promote economic and trade exchanges between our country and Latin American nations."
China Airlines said it would use a Boeing 747-200 jet for the new service that started on Friday, it said.
Taiwan, under a constant diplomatic squeeze by rival China, has pledged repeatedly to step up trade and investment in Central America to boost relations with its allies there.
Most of Taiwan's 30 diplomatic allies are underdeveloped states in Africa and central America.
Taiwan and China split after a civil war in 1949.
Beijing considers Taiwan a renegade province and seeks to isolate the island completely from international arenas until it can be reunified under mainland sovereignty.
